query: Bill the Handyman LLC, Clearwater, FL

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Meghan Moeltner
reviewSamples.text: Bill did an incredible job at my home! He took care of a lot of different needs I had such as mounting TVs, installing security cameras, building bookcases, removing fans/lights, etc. He was punctual, friendly, and did an amazing job! I will definitely use his services again in the future.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Gabi Hazim
reviewSamples.text: Messaged Bill Monday morning to clean out AC unit as it wasn’t running. He was able to come within a couple hours. Cost for very affordable and wouldn’t charge if he couldn’t fix. Bill was able to fix it and AC ran perfectly again. This is the second time Bill was able to help with our house repairs!
